result.description: Nimbus Arc 27Q is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for editorial work, office productivity, and long-form reading comfort. It features a QHD 2560 x 1440 panel, IPS-style wide viewing angles, anti-glare coating, and a fully adjustable stand with tilt, swivel, pivot, and height control. The display emphasizes eye comfort with a low-blue-light mode, flicker-reduction backlight, and a matte finish rather than gaming-focused speed or workstation graphics specialization. Connectivity includes DisplayPort, HDMI, and USB-C with simple peripheral passthrough. This model is positioned as a balanced productivity screen for home offices and studio desks.
result.title: Nimbus Arc 27Q Ergonomic Monitor 27-inch QHD
